items.claim: Two facts inside oshb:Ezek.20.1-Ezek.20.26 go unweighed. The mark list carries two marks on this span's verses, a samekh after oshb:Ezek.20.1 and a samekh after oshb:Ezek.20.26, and only the second is disclosed; the first falls at the very junction the onset argument welds, between the date-and-elders frame at oshb:Ezek.20.1 and the word-event at oshb:Ezek.20.2, so the tradition's own division there is single-witness evidence this unit never weighs. And the denial that nothing formula-marked interrupts between the two onsets is false: a messenger formula stands at oshb:Ezek.20.5, and another at oshb:Ezek.20.3, both listed in the 122-verse long-form messenger census. Smaller: the mark-position denial in the device prose rides behind a comma at oshb:Ezek.20.1.
items.both_sides: Onset side: the year-bearing date at oshb:Ezek.20.1 with the pe after oshb:Ezek.19.14 behind it, and the word-event at oshb:Ezek.20.2 inside that frame; the samekh after oshb:Ezek.20.1 is tier-3 single-witness evidence that the tradition sets the frame verse apart, which informs the reading and does not move the onset off oshb:Ezek.20.1. Close side: oshb:Ezek.20.26 ends on a knowing-clause built with the relative particle rather than the causal one, so it lies outside both the 28-verse strict recognition census and the wider causal-particle family sweep, and the samekh after it is the corroboration; the next unit's onset at oshb:Ezek.20.27 carries the therefore-particle, the son-of-man address and a messenger formula together. Both sides hold and the seam at oshb:Ezek.20.26 / oshb:Ezek.20.27 stands, so the 26-verse span keeps, with its size disclosure and its medium_low grade unchanged.

items.claim: The close side of oshb:Ezek.20.27-Ezek.20.29 carries no device of the book's close classes: oshb:Ezek.20.29 ends on the naming tag that gives the high place its name to this day, and the messenger formula leaned on as the close trigger at oshb:Ezek.20.30 answers neither condition the book sets before a messenger formula may open a unit. The addressee named in the command is the house of Israel at oshb:Ezek.20.30 exactly as at oshb:Ezek.20.27, and no refrain closes oshb:Ezek.20.29; the mark list carries three ch-20 verses, oshb:Ezek.20.1, oshb:Ezek.20.26 and oshb:Ezek.20.44, so there is no mark at that seam either. Continuity that is not disclosed runs across both of this unit's seams: the oath-and-refusal pair stands at oshb:Ezek.20.31 as it does at oshb:Ezek.20.3, a clause-level recurrence and not a byte-identical run, since the utterance signature sits before the refusal at oshb:Ezek.20.31 and after it at oshb:Ezek.20.3; and the gift-and-passing language of oshb:Ezek.20.26 returns at oshb:Ezek.20.31.
items.both_sides: Onset side is strong and correctly argued: the samekh after oshb:Ezek.20.26 with that verse's knowing-clause behind it, then the therefore-particle plus the son-of-man address plus a messenger formula at oshb:Ezek.20.27, with the paired speak-and-say imperatives; of the three ch-20 verses in the 93-verse son-of-man census, oshb:Ezek.20.3, oshb:Ezek.20.4 and oshb:Ezek.20.27, only the last stands at a proposed onset. Close side has nothing of that grade: oshb:Ezek.20.30 carries a bare say-imperative with a messenger formula, no son-of-man address, no addressee change, no mark on oshb:Ezek.20.29 and no refrain before it. The two sides cannot jointly carry a medium grade; the adjudicable alternative is one unit oshb:Ezek.20.27-Ezek.20.38 closing on the second-person-plural knowing-refrain at oshb:Ezek.20.38, which would leave the narrated generations, the fathers' trespass and the present-generation accusation in two units rather than three.

items.claim: The high grade rests on one side only. The close is refrain-grade and correctly argued: oshb:Ezek.20.38 ends on the second-person-plural knowing-form, which this unit rightly cites as the wider 21-verse sweep and not the 28-verse strict census. The onset at oshb:Ezek.20.30 answers neither condition the book sets before a messenger formula may open a unit: the addressee named in the command is the house of Israel there as at oshb:Ezek.20.27, and no refrain closes oshb:Ezek.20.29. Undisclosed as well is the clause-level return at oshb:Ezek.20.31 of the oath-and-refusal pair of oshb:Ezek.20.3, which straddles this unit's own onset seam; and the mark-position denial rides behind a comma for oshb:Ezek.20.30 and oshb:Ezek.20.32.
items.both_sides: Onset side: a messenger formula with a bare say-imperative at oshb:Ezek.20.30, no addressee change from oshb:Ezek.20.27, and neither refrain nor mark behind it, which is the weaker side. Close side: the second-person-plural knowing-refrain at oshb:Ezek.20.38 followed by the vocative-plus-messenger onset at oshb:Ezek.20.39, which is the shape the book licenses. The internal oath at oshb:Ezek.20.33 is correctly read as paragraph-internal, since no fresh onset follows it, and the single-movement reading of oshb:Ezek.20.30-Ezek.20.38 holds on the bytes; what does not hold is a high grade on a seam whose onset side the book's own rule does not license.

items.claim: The onset ground is false on the bytes: what closes immediately before oshb:Ezek.20.39 is not a third-person indictment. The unit oshb:Ezek.20.30-Ezek.20.38 addresses Israel in the second person plural throughout, at oshb:Ezek.20.30 (you are defiling yourselves), at oshb:Ezek.20.33 (I will be king over you) and at oshb:Ezek.20.38 (and you shall know that I am YHWH), so a shift out of third person cannot be the warrant. The seam is licensed from the other side instead: the second-person-plural knowing-refrain closes oshb:Ezek.20.38 immediately before the messenger formula, which is the condition under which a messenger formula may open a unit, and the vocative addressed to the house of Israel opens oshb:Ezek.20.39.

This unit's own close: the second-person-plural knowing-refrain with the utterance signature at oshb:Ezek.20.44 and the pe after that verse, the second such refrain inside the span after oshb:Ezek.20.42; behind the close stands the word-event at web:Ezek.20.45 = oshb:Ezek.21.1. Span, unit reading and the high grade all stand, and the refusal to cut on either witness's chapter numbering is correct; only the stated ground needs replacing.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Whether the turn at oshb:Ezek.20.30 from the fathers' record to the present generation counts as the addressee change the book requires before a messenger formula may open a unit. On the wording of the commands it does not: the addressee named at oshb:Ezek.20.27 and at oshb:Ezek.20.30 is the house of Israel in both, and only the subject of the accusation moves.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: It decides whether two units or one stand between the samekh after oshb:Ezek.20.26 and the refrain at oshb:Ezek.20.38, and it sets the grade of both units that share that seam. I proposed grade moves rather than a respan because a three-verse unit with a genuine onset should not be dissolved on one lens's reading.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Whether the samekh the mark list records after oshb:Ezek.20.1 weighs against reading that verse as a narrative frame whose word-event at oshb:Ezek.20.2 is the oracle's onset inside it. The list gives no position within the verse and the mark is single-witness.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The same frame-plus-word-event reading governs the book's other undated-frame onsets, so a settled answer is reusable; read as a boundary the mark would put the onset at oshb:Ezek.20.2 and leave the date in a one-verse unit, which the size rules would then have to justify.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: The mirroring flags on five of my six units name references argued in prose but absent from the boundary-evidence list: oshb:Ezek.19.14 in the unit opening at oshb:Ezek.20.1; oshb:Ezek.20.26 in the unit opening at oshb:Ezek.20.27; web:Ezek.20.49 = oshb:Ezek.21.5 in the unit opening at oshb:Ezek.20.39; the MT-side coordinates of the zone references in the unit opening at web:Ezek.20.45 = oshb:Ezek.21.1; and web:Ezek.20.45 = oshb:Ezek.21.1 together with web:Ezek.20.48 = oshb:Ezek.21.4 in the unit opening at web:Ezek.21.1 = oshb:Ezek.21.6. I verified each of those facts against the mark list, the paseq list and the verse bytes and each is true.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: They are mirroring gaps rather than false claims, so they are not defects of fact; whether a mark reference outside the span, or a reference used inside a rejected alternative, must also appear in the mirrored list is a contract question I cannot settle from my inputs.
